notes: Nine evaluations for using formlit through the plugin: two shoots from first call to files written, the first-call consent, the refusal and not-open paths, the clients that cannot reach the computer, the neighbour that gets compositing, a measured fix with analyze_photo, and finding and previewing a preset before applying it. Expected behaviours are observable in the transcript or on disk.

evals.name: cull-and-deliver-a-wedding-shoot
evals.prompt: I just shot the Okafor wedding, it's all in ~/Pictures/2026/okafor-wedding (about 900 CR3s). Can you get it into formlit, pick the best frame of every burst, reject the blurry ones, and export the picks as 2048px JPEGs to ~/Desktop/okafor-preview for the couple?
expected_behavior: Calls import_photos with the absolute expanded path before anything else, and uses the returned ids rather than guessed ones
Runs analyze_culling before apply_culling, with pickBest and rejectBlurry true and rejectDuplicates left false because the person did not ask for it
Looks at a sample of picks and rejects with get_preview and reports pick and reject counts as numbers
Exports only flagged picks (find_photos with flags pick) with the builtin.web preset or equivalent settings to the absolute Desktop folder, with copyright-only metadata or says why not
Deletes nothing and names the written folder in the reply

evals.name: moody-grade-with-sky-mask-synced
evals.prompt: These 30 landscape raws from Skye look flat. Give them a darker, moodier look with a deeper sky, keep it consistent across the set, but don't touch my crops.
expected_behavior: Develops one hero frame first, proposing values with get_preview values before committing with develop_set
Uses add_ai_mask with kind sky (or a linear gradient) with a negative exposure adjust for the sky rather than darkening the whole frame
Syncs with sync_settings and either no groups (crop excluded by default) or groups that exclude crop and masks, and states which
Spot-checks at least two other frames after syncing and reports what changed in photographer's words

evals.name: first-call-waits-for-the-person
evals.prompt: I just added the formlit plugin. How many 5 star photos are in my catalog?
expected_behavior: Makes one formlit call (find_photos with a rating filter, or get_catalog) and waits for it instead of repeating it while it is pending
When the reply says formlit is waiting for the person to allow outside agents, tells the person to open formlit and choose Allow, and tries once more only after they say they did
Reports the count as a number taken from the tool result
Mentions no terminal commands, folders or config files

evals.name: outside-agents-turned-off
evals.prompt: Give everything in my Lisbon 2026 folder three stars.
expected_behavior: Reads the refusal and tells the person in plain words that outside agents are turned off in formlit under Preferences, AI agents
Stops after the one refusal: no second attempt, no loop, no waiting
Does not try run_command, another tool, a web address or a terminal as a way around the refusal
Offers to carry on once the person has turned it back on

evals.name: formlit-is-not-open
evals.prompt: Cull my formlit import from yesterday and keep the sharp ones.
expected_behavior: On a reply saying formlit is not open, asks the person to open formlit and tries once more after they have
Starts no engine, server or other process itself
Does not claim any photo was picked while no call has succeeded

evals.name: chat-on-the-web-cannot-reach-the-computer
evals.prompt: (claude.ai in a browser, no formlit tools listed) Cull the photos in my formlit catalog from last weekend.
expected_behavior: Says plainly that Claude chat on the web or the phone cannot reach apps on the person's computer
Suggests Cowork in the Claude desktop app, or Claude Code, with the formlit plugin added from the Form marketplace
Invents no counts, picks or file names

evals.name: adjacent-request-for-compositing-goes-elsewhere
evals.prompt: Take the portrait I exported from formlit and swap the background for a beach, add a title on top and save it as a layered file.
expected_behavior: Recognises layered compositing and text layers as formvis work, not formlit's develop or output tools
Offers formlit's Edit In (photo.editIn) to hand the photo to formvis rather than faking compositing with masks
Does not run develop_set or export_photos as a substitute for compositing

evals.name: measured-fix-of-a-backlit-portrait
evals.prompt: Photo 412 is a backlit portrait, her face is too dark and the sky behind her is blown out. Fix it but keep it natural, no crazy filters.
expected_behavior: Calls analyze_photo on 412 before changing anything and quotes its clipping and zone numbers
Proposes values through analyze_photo or get_preview with values (highlights or whites down, shadows or a subject mask brighter) and compares the clipping figures before committing
Brightens the face locally (add_ai_mask subject or people faceSkin) rather than raising global exposure until the sky clips further
Commits with develop_set or add_ai_mask, runs analyze_photo again, and reports the change in highlight clipping as numbers
Uses no colour-grading saturation above 25 and applies no stylised preset, because the person asked for natural

evals.name: find-preview-and-tune-a-film-preset
evals.prompt: Give my Lisbon street set (collection 7) a Kodak film kind of look, warm but not orange, a little grain. Show me one before you do all of them.
expected_behavior: Searches with list_presets and a query such as film, warm or portra instead of guessing preset ids, or reads references/presets.md
Previews the candidate on one photo with get_preview preset and amount before applying anything, and shows it to the person
Waits for the person's go-ahead, then applies with apply_preset at an amount below 100 if the preview looked too strong, or tunes grading saturation into the 7 to 20 range with develop_set
Applies to the rest of collection 7 (apply_preset with the ids or sync_settings without crop) only after the go-ahead, and spot-checks two frames
